text:
sasha: Cutting RC-2 at 10:00 PT. PR #7234 (kv-cache-regen) needs 2x LGTM before cutoff — CI is green but we saw flaky failures on smoke-3 earlier. anyone available for a quick second eye? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar: I can take a look in ~15m.

rachel: pinging @tom @maria for a quick review as well. this is mostly test stabilization + a tiny impl tweak. low risk.

tom: skimming now. quick note — failing locally for me is the smoke-3 timeout in setup. trying a reproduce: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh smoke-3 --seed=42`

deploy-bot: Merge window scheduled at 2054324000 (10:00 PT). Merges will be held if required approvals are missing.

tom: found a race in test fixture, pushing a tiny fix to the branch (will force-push). will request review after CI rerun.

sasha: thanks Tom. Omar — can you re-review after Tom's push? we still need one more LGTM before cutoff.

omar: saw the push, running CI locally now. if CI is flaky I can do a manual sanity run against staging. ETA ~20m.

rachel: if CI flakes again, decide at cutoff whether to hold RC. rollback plan is to drop this change and ship the rest.

sasha: tagging release lead @maria — preference on hold vs roll without kv change if we miss cutoff?

maria: prefer to hold this one — low importance for immediate RC. but if we're blocked >30m past cutoff we can roll without it. will coordinate with infra on post-rollback run if needed. :+1:

sasha: perfect. I'll update this thread as soon as Omar approves or if CI fails. thanks all for the quick turnaround.
